svg.title: Tracking events through a funnel
svg.desc: Tracking events and the engine events that send them, across a funnel. On every page: page_view on sdk.ready; add_to_cart, remove_from_cart and update_cart on cart.calculated; view_promotion on promotion.viewed and select_promotion on promotion.clicked. Landing: view_item for one package on the page, view_item_list for several, on sdk.ready. Checkout: begin_checkout on checkout.started, generate_lead on user.created, add_shipping_info on address.entered, add_payment_info on checkout.submitted, purchase on order.paid. Upsell: view_upsell on upsell.viewed, skip_upsell on upsell.skipped, upsell_purchase on order.loaded for the upsell accepted on the page before. Receipt: upsell_purchase on order.loaded, and purchase on order.loaded only when the checkout page was left before it was sent.
